Design System

Fixture & <Co> · Heritage signboard

Concept

Old-quarter shop signboards: lacquer-red boards with gold-leaf lettering on aged paper; ink-black text; serif display set large like carved characters.

Why (style guide)

DecisionBecause
Accent = ink (giay-900), not lacquer red: red is the error hue; an ink button keeps the primary action calm and lets red mean 'signboard' (brand surfaces) instead of 'danger'.
Neutrals are tinted toward paper (hue 80) at the same temperature as the gold, so paper, ink and gold read as one material family.
Display scale 30/42/60/85 at √2 ratio: carved-signboard titles need big jumps; UI text stays at a calm 1.2 ratio.
Gold is the signature (ornament and text on lacquer)gold on paper cannot reach 4.5:1 for small text.

Do

  • Set display titles big (42-85) and let them breathe.
  • Use gold only as ornament and thin rules.
  • Use real product photography on paper backgrounds.

Don't

  • Gold text on paper below 18px.
  • Gradients, glass, glows.
  • More than one framed signboard block per view.

Layout and grid

Desktop 12 columns, content 1200, gutters 24, generous top whitespace above display titles; mobile 2-column product grid, margins 16.

Signature motifs

signboard-frame
Hero blocks and brand panels: double frame (gold inner rule inside a lacquer board). One per screen.
gold-rule
Section dividers: short gold rule with a centred diamond. Never under every heading.

Component rules

  • Buttons 14/600, radius 2-4: ink primary, outline secondary; lacquer only on brand bands with gold text.
  • Eyebrow caps 12/600 tracking 0.16em above display titles (ink on paper; gold only on lacquer).
  • Product names in display serif 22, exactly two lines.
  • Price in display serif, never "0 ₫" (show "Liên hệ").

Design System

Fixture & <Co> · Heritage signboard

Concept

Old-quarter shop signboards: lacquer-red boards with gold-leaf lettering on aged paper; ink-black text; serif display set large like carved characters.

Why (DESIGN.md)

DecisionBecause
Accent is one blue stepoperators scan for the single action per view
Neutrals lean warmthe paper forms they replace are cream
Type scale is 1.2tables need many sizes close together
Nohere, just a rule that spans the two columns
a nested bulletindentation is allowed

Do

  • Set display titles big (42-85) and let them breathe.
  • Use gold only as ornament and thin rules.
  • Use real product photography on paper backgrounds.

Don't

  • Gold text on paper below 18px.
  • Gradients, glass, glows.
  • More than one framed signboard block per view.

Layout and grid

Desktop 12 columns, content 1200, gutters 24, generous top whitespace above display titles; mobile 2-column product grid, margins 16.

Signature motifs

signboard-frame
Hero blocks and brand panels: double frame (gold inner rule inside a lacquer board). One per screen.
gold-rule
Section dividers: short gold rule with a centred diamond. Never under every heading.

Component rules

  • Buttons 14/600, radius 2-4: ink primary, outline secondary; lacquer only on brand bands with gold text.
  • Eyebrow caps 12/600 tracking 0.16em above display titles (ink on paper; gold only on lacquer).
  • Product names in display serif 22, exactly two lines.
  • Price in display serif, never "0 ₫" (show "Liên hệ").

A dispatch board: compact condensed type, cool greys, signal colours used sparingly, everything aligned to columns so 50 rows fit on screen.

DecisionBecause
Accent is one blue stepoperators scan for the single action per view
Neutrals lean warmthe paper forms they replace are cream
Type scale is 1.2tables need many sizes close together
Nohere, just a rule that spans the two columns
a nested bulletindentation is allowed

Don't
